name: Akemine Miyuu
source:
Likes: Family
Dislikes: Bugs, ghosts

Despite her extremely young appearance, Miyuu is the wife of Itsuki's homeroom teacher Hirotaka (is not legally married and is in "de facto marriage") and a mother. She has a sweet, childish voice but she is also able to make valid and smart points just a like a normal adult.
